# G2 Track

> > G2 Track is a SaaS management platform that provides visibility, control, and cost optimization for enterprise software portfolios.

G2 Track helps organizations discover, manage, and optimize their SaaS spending through automated tracking, vendor management, and data-driven intelligence. The platform addresses critical challenges including shadow IT visibility, license compliance, budget forecasting, and security risk mitigation.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Management
- Cost Optimization
- Spend Management
- Shadow IT
- License Management
- Vendor Management
- Budget Optimization
- SaaS Security
- Software Asset Management
- Compliance
- Data Protection
- G2 Track Essential
